interactions.summary: Initial discovery call. Priya flagged a budget freeze until Q3. Interested but non-committal. Comparing with Salesforce.
Second call. Pushed back on onboarding timeline — wants setup complete in under 2 weeks. Raised Salesforce again as a benchmark. Asked for a case study from a similar company.
Demo call. Loved the ROI calculator — asked to keep access. Requested a pilot with 3 reps before committing. Onboarding timeline still a concern.
Follow-up. Agreed to the 3-rep pilot starting next month. Budget approved post-Q3. New concern: data migration from their current CRM.
Cold outreach converted to a call. James is evaluating 3 vendors. Primary concern is API reliability — they had a bad experience with their last provider going down during peak hours.
Technical deep dive. His engineering lead joined. They grilled us on uptime SLAs. Positive reaction to the 99.9% guarantee. James asked for a security audit report.
Sent the security report. James liked it but legal is reviewing. He mentioned one competitor offered a lower price. May need a discounted pilot to move forward.
First call. Sarah was warm but distracted. Her team is mid-reorg. She asked to reconnect in 6 weeks when things settle. No objections raised — just bad timing.
Reconnect as scheduled. Reorg is done. New focus on scaling partner integrations. Very interested in our API. Asked for pricing for 10 seats.

Intro call via LinkedIn referral. Marcus is looking for a solution to replace spreadsheet-based pipeline tracking. Budget is there, timeline is Q4. Main concern is change management — his team resists new tools.
Second call. Showed him the onboarding flow. He appreciated the simplicity. Still worried about team adoption. Asked if we could do a lunch-and-learn session with his 8 reps.

First call. Anika is highly technical and asked detailed questions about our data model. She flagged GDPR compliance as a hard requirement — they process EU customer data. Needs a DPA signed before moving forward.
